text:
maria: Heads up — we're planning a minimal base-image rebuild tonight at 23:00 UTC to pick up distro patches for openssl and busybox and to enable cosign attestation. Need quick sync on RBAC, KMS, and canary policy.
dan: 👍 what's the canary window?
maria: 30m in prod, 15m in staging. We'll deploy to staging 22:15 UTC.
ravi: For KMS: are we rotating the signing key or just adding a new key? rotation impacts cosign verification and verifier configs.
maria: Adding a new signing key and keeping the old key in the keyring for 7 days. Need eng-infra to provision key and grant the signer SA the right permissions.
jen: I can add RBAC. What exact roles does the service account need?
jen: Service account should have roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner and roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer (or equivalent). Also roles/storage.objectViewer on the build bucket for the signer.
ops-oncall: If canary fails, what's the rollback plan? immediate traffic shift? who performs it?
maria: Rollout policy: 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 30m with automated monitors. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate > 3% or median latency +50ms. ops-oncall will be primary to execute emergency rollback; eng-runtime will hold the rollback playbook.
sec-bot: Vulnerability scan: 4 medium findings (libcrypto 1.1.x, zlib) — distro patches available. No critical/high. CVE refs attached in the scan report link https://scans.prod/rebuild/21678
ravi: For audit logs we need KMS access logs and cosign verification events retained for 90 days. Compliance asked for 13 months of provenance metadata. Storage implications?
maria: We'll forward cosign verification events + KMS logs to long-term logs bucket with lifecycle 13 months. ops to confirm cost impact.
keith: About provenance and SBOMs — should the pipeline attach SBOM + cosign signature + provenance.json to the image manifest?
maria: yes. Pipeline outputs: sbom.json, provenance.json, cosign.sig alongside the image. Runtime verifier must check sbom hash matches provenance before allowing traffic.
jen: I'll draft RBAC PR for the signer SA and a small KMS IAM guide. tagging @ravi @keith for approvals.
ravi: I'll add verifier middleware changes to ensure we fetch the active keyset from KMS and fall back to previous key for 7 days. Also adding a small grace window for public key caching.
maria: One more item: runtime cache invalidation — images rebuilt with new base may need edge cache purge to avoid pulling stale layers.
ops-oncall: Noted. I'll run the cache purge job in the post-cutover step. Quick command we use: `scripts/purge-image-cache --image my-registry.io/rebuild:latest`
maria: Example cosign sign command for infra reference:
```
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/image-signer my-registry.io/rebuild:sha256-abc123
```
keith: I'll prepare the canary dashboard and watch the metrics during rollout.
jen: PR incoming in ~30m, will include example IAM snippets.
maria: I'll open a runbook and attach the vuln triage doc + canary dashboard links. Target start 23:00 UTC. Ping if you can't make it.
jen: on it. :thumbsup:
keith: will watch canary and standby for rollback.
